intro: A glass of sweetened air soya from a stall is about 140 kcal (estimate). Around half comes from the soya beans. The rest comes from the added sugar or syrup.
diet: Yes, and it's one of the better drink choices at a stall. You get a bit of protein from the soya beans. But the sweetened version still has quite a lot of added sugar. If you can get it less sweet or with no sugar, even better.
tips: Look for stalls that sell 'kosong' or less sweet soya.
Buy unsweetened soya and add a little sugar yourself at home, to your taste.
Drink it with breakfast for extra protein, not as a separate snack.

swap.name: Air soya, no sugar
swap.why: Same protein, about 50 kcal less because there's no added sugar.

faq.q: How long does air soya last in the fridge?
faq.a: Fresh air soya usually keeps for 1-2 days in the fridge. If it smells sour or turns lumpy, don't drink it.

faq.q: Can air soya replace cow's milk?
faq.a: Yes, as an alternative, especially if you're lactose intolerant. The calcium content is different, so make sure you get enough calcium from other foods.

faq.q: Can men drink air soya often?
faq.a: For most healthy adults, drinking soya in normal amounts is okay. If you have a specific health condition, check with your doctor.
